summary: JTA, Jewish Insider, and the Baltimore Jewish Times characterize David Jolly's congressional record as 'pro-Israel' or 'moderate, pro-Israel' from August through October 2026, and his governor's campaign platform contains no position on Israel or Palestine. The repeated external characterization, running from his primary win into the general-election period, places his documented record on the pro-Israel side.
